Contains ZERO meat or egg keywords across all 30 published days — it is the only fixture that exercises the messServesNonVeg:false branch of the diet resolver against real data. This menu is the special mess's menu with the non-veg items removed, so the same dish strings appear in both files: 'Salna' and 'Pasta' are unknown-by-keyword and must resolve veg HERE and unknown in hostel-2-mess-1. Real defects retained verbatim: double comma ('Mix Dhal,,', 'Idly,,', 'Butter milk,,'), missing space after comma ('Roti,Channa Masala', 'Dhal,White Rice', 'Chapathi,Yellow Dhal'), double space ('Dhal Makani,  Rasam', 'Phulka,  White kurma'). Kept dates preserve four 14-day cycle pairs: 01==15, 02==16, 06==20, 07==21.
